config.decision_rule: A design helps if, in at least 2 of its 3 CEM runs, the 95% bootstrap CI of the paired race-time difference (tuned minus hand-set rule-based, 40 held-out races) lies entirely below 0. Fixed before running.
config.name: scenario_coverage
config.question: Does tuning RuleBased's four thresholds on a scenario-stratified training set (2 quiet, 2 VSC/SC, 2 wet races) beat the hand-set rule on held-out races, where tuning on the same number of randomly drawn races does not?
